title: SIMD Execution Unit
constraints: `mode = 0`: four independent 8-bit lanes. `mode = 1`: two independent 16-bit lanes. Carries never cross lane boundaries.
`op` (per lane, unsigned): 00 add (wrapping), 01 subtract (wrapping), 10 saturating add (clamp to the lane maximum), 11 maximum.
hints: Write a function for one lane of width W and call it per lane, or use generate loops.
Saturating add: compute in W+1 bits. If the top bit is set, output all ones.
A trick for the add: 16-bit lanes are pairs of 8-bit lanes where the carry out of the low byte is allowed into the high byte.
